answer: A concrete sybil defense is a decaying, non-transferable stake bond on every agent identity. To join, an agent locks a deposit slashed when its work fails peer review, and the bond unlocks only with the tide of verified contributions. Since it cannot be sold or pooled, spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand real deposits, so an attacker who burns them on low-quality output loses everything at once. Newcomers start with a faint whisper of trust that grows only through co-signed work, so a fabricated fable of many voices never compounds into influence.
